facts.text: Tahoe Park lies less than a mile southwest of California State University, a mile east of the UC Davis Medical Center, and about four miles southeast of downtown Sacramento.
When Sacramento bought 19 acres south of Tahoe Elementary School in 1946, the new park was christened Tahoe Park in honor of the school.
Since the 1990s, Tahoe Park has received street lights, a jogging trail, upgraded picnic areas, and fitness stations to enhance visitor experience.
Tahoe Park is bounded by 14th Avenue to the north, 21st Avenue to the south, 58th Street to the west, and the 65th Street Expressway to the east.
The 19‑acre Tahoe Park recreational facility occupies 77,000 square meters of green space within Sacramento’s Tahoe Park neighborhood.
